messages:
incident-bot: Paging oncall: Elevated 5xx rate detected for Dedicated cluster 'dedicated-eu-west-1-3' affecting customer PelagoFin. Alert rule: gateway_5xx_rate > 3% over 5m.

sylvie: I'm on it, grabbing context. what's the impact window?

ryan_oncall: getting alerted too. seeing spike started ~10:02 UTC. Dashboard shows 5xx trending from 0.4% -> 8% in ~7m. Latency up too.

marta_support: PelagoFin reported intermittent failures on their live checkout pages via a support ticket; they've linked request IDs. They say ~30% of checkout attempts failing for last 6m.

devin_infra: checking node-level metrics. GPU memory on gpool-42 at 98% and evictions happening. Probable noisy neighbor on that host.

sylvie: can you share the node pod list and eviction logs?

devin_infra: pasted logs: ```
[2026-02-20T10:04:21Z] eviction: OOM-kill invoked on container model-runner-abc
[2026-02-20T10:04:22Z] cgroup: memory limit breach, preemption triggered
[2026-02-20T10:04:23Z] scheduler: pods moved -> gpool-43
```

ryan_oncall: confirms fallback routing kicked in but some routes attempted to retry and hit gateway 502s while model warmups were happening.

sylvie: do we have request traces linking PelagoFin tenant->gpool-42?

devin_infra: yes. sample trace: `tenant=pelagofin request_id=abc123 route=/v1/generate model=vicuna-13b-quant` landed on gpool-42 and got 502 during kv-cache init.

nate_prod: PelagoFin is on a Dedicated reservation with strict latency SLAs. We need to limit scope of impact and explain to CS/AM.

marta_support: I've DM'd PelagoFin: "We're investigating. Temporary mitigation in progress, will follow up with root cause and ETA." They replied: "App is customer-facing; please prioritize."

sylvie: quick mitigation plan: 1) cordon and drain the hot host to stop noisy tenant; 2) apply short-term per-tenant concurrency cap for PelagoFin to reduce retry storm; 3) scale up dedicated pool if autoscale can't catch up; 4) post-incident follow-up (quota/tuning).

devin_infra: starting drain on gpool-42 now: `kubectl drain gpool-42 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` (will trigger pod reschedules).

ops-bot: Drain initiated by devin_infra at 10:08 UTC. Reschedule count: 12.

ryan_oncall: also enabling route-level fallback to smaller model variant to reduce memory pressure: update routing policy to map vicuna-13b-quant -> vicuna-7b-quant for PelagoFin for next 10m.

nate_prod: Approved. Doing the routing change: ```
PATCH /routing/policies/tenants/pelagofin
{ "traffic_shift": [{"from_model":"vicuna-13b-quant","to_model":"vicuna-7b-quant","percent":100}], "duration_sec": 600 }
```

silvie: (typo) sylvie: good. watch for quality alerts; notify PelagoFin if quality changes.

devin_infra: drain completed @10:12. gpool-42 now cordoned; most pods scheduled on gpool-43/gpool-44. GPU mem on gpool-43 peaked but stable now (72%).

incident-bot: Autoscaler triggered +2 nodes in dedicated-eu-west-1-3 at 10:13 UTC. Expected healthy in ~3m.

ryan_oncall: checking error rate after actions. 5xx dropped from 8% -> 1.6% within 4m. Latency tail still elevated but improving.

marta_support: PelagoFin acknowledges temporary fallback. They've asked if we can reduce retries on client side — suggested backoff config in SDK.

sylvie: lowering retry attempts on gateway side for PelagoFin to reduce retry amplification: set max_retries=1 for tenant route. Updating now.

devin_infra: applied `max_retries=1`. Also blacklisted the noisy pod image `bench-loading:edge` that caused runaway memory.

ryan_oncall: monitoring: 5xx now at 0.5% and trending down. No new evictions.

nate_prod: Customer impact summary (initial): - window: 10:02-10:14 UTC - peak error rate: ~8% - affected endpoints: /v1/generate (checkout flows) - impacted users: PelagoFin production traffic; estimated 27% of their requests failed at peak.

marta_support: sending update to PelagoFin: "We've routed your traffic to a compatible lower-memory model and drained an affected host. Errors are decreasing; we'll follow up with full RCA."

sylvie: action items: (1) RCA on noisy tenant/process that allocated memory without cgroup limits; (2) add tenant-level burst controls in Dedicated; (3) improve warmup redirects for model swaps to avoid 502s during cold start; (4) update runbook so oncall can do per-tenant concurrency caps faster.

devin_infra: I'll open infra ticket and attach kube-eviction traces and host forensic logs.

nate_prod: I'll coordinate postmortem and customer-facing timeline; flag for account team.

incident-bot: Incident severity lowered to S2 at 10:29 UTC. All hands no longer needed; oncall to monitor.

ryan_oncall: staying on watch for 30m. If error rate climbs above 2% we escalate.

marta_support: PelagoFin replied: ":thumbsup: Thanks. Please keep us posted."

sylvie: Thanks team. Saving logs and will start RCA doc.

-- end of thread --
